title: Add Cave widget to patient workspace
description:
Add a Cave (contraindication/allergy alert) widget to the patient workspace. The widget shows active cave entries from Aidbox and allows practitioners to add new cave flags.

API: POST /api/practitioner/cave/add, GET /api/practitioner/cave/list
Database: reads cave_catalog, writes to proposal_table

## MoC

| # | AC | MoC | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Cave widget renders existing cave entries | E2E | apps/web/src/workspace/CaveWidget.test.tsx |
| 2 | Practitioner can add new cave flag | E2E | playwright/cave-add.spec.ts |
| 3 | Cave flag stored as AllergyIntolerance in Aidbox | integ | apps/api/tests/cave-storage.test.ts |
acceptance_criteria:
- Cave widget renders existing cave entries for the current patient
- Practitioner can add a new cave flag via the widget
- New cave flag is stored as AllergyIntolerance resource in Aidbox
- Widget updates without page reload after adding a cave flag

metadata.intent: Surface cave alerts prominently in the patient workspace so practitioners can quickly identify contraindications. Scope IN: CaveWidget component, cave API endpoints, Aidbox write. Scope OUT: Cave history, deletion, approval flow.
